landing.attribution: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation · Government of India
landing.searchPlaceholder: Search by Case ID, Work ID, District, or MP…
landing.caveat: Measured on twelve published exports from the MPLADS national portal. All figures verified by reproducible SHA-256 audit runs.
landing.emblemAlt: Government of India / Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation Emblem
landing.section1Title: Anomalies identified across the national corpus
landing.section1Subtitle: Deterministic algorithmic scoring against published MoSPI guidelines.
landing.card1Text: Normalises disparate state-level datasets, vendor invoices, and work sanctions across 31 states and UTs into a unified verifiable format.
landing.card2Text: Evaluates every work item against codified scheme rules: cost-splitting thresholds, duplicate descriptions, stalled disbursements, and agency concentration.
landing.card3Text: Generates immutable cryptographic hashes and clear citation memos for every identified anomaly. Officers inspect the raw evidence before taking action.
landing.previewSubtitle: Cases flagged for priority review by District Authorities and State Nodal Officers.
